claims.statement: The shadcn full-UI migration program (Epics 166–174) migrates the frontend presentation layer one BMAD Story at a time while preserving backend contracts, calculations, query keys, URLs/search parameters, authentication, cabinet context, Russian localization, and formatting semantics; the only approved contract exceptions are Stories 167.8 and 169.14, executed in the backend repository.

Program completion requires exactly 94 stories with matching OMX plans and completion evidence, all 76 page.tsx routes verified exactly once via the route ledger, legacy presentation removed only after its last consumer migrates, and every temporary worktree/branch removed after merge; production/deployment and CI gates are out of scope.

Epic 174 is a sequential consolidation chain: 174.1 (parity proof) and 174.2 (legacy removal + design-system boundary) are done; 174.3 is in active remediation; 174.4 (functional/backend-contract regression) and 174.5 (final documentation, verified routes, cleanup) remain.

Story 174.1's validator scripts/check-shadcn-migration-parity.mjs proves schema-v3 parity (94 BMAD stories = 94 OMX plans, 76 source routes = 76 ledger rows = 76 unique route-owning stories = 76 unique linked implementation artifacts), runs a 33-test deterministic node:test mutation suite, and intentionally did not flip ledger rows to verified — Story 174.5 owns those transitions, so all 76 route-ledger rows remain planned.

scripts/check-shadcn-ui-boundary.mjs is a node-stdlib-only scanner over production src/**/*.{ts,tsx} detecting the LEGACY_PALETTE regex and 3-branch CONTEXTUAL_HEX canon, with a ratchet baseline of 459 counted violations at scripts/.shadcn-ui-boundary-baseline.txt (exit 0 at or below, fail only on increase; born at 523 in Story 174.2, ratcheted down by 174.4) and 3 suppressed matches in 3 files via BOUNDARY_EXCEPTIONS (C5 waterfall hex + two historical #7C3AED chart marks; the FeedbackButtons exception was lifted 2026-09-02 when PB-4 was fixed).

Story 174.3 executes the complete 76-route inclusive visual matrix over the canonical twelve-state ledger taxonomy (default/loading/refresh/empty/filtered-empty/error/stale/partial/permission/pending/partial-success/not-found) across light and dark themes, six widths (320/390/768/1024/1280/1440), reduced motion, axe WCAG 2 A/AA/2.2 AA at 390px and 1280px, keyboard/focus paths, reading/heading order, and non-color data meaning.

The generated register _bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/174-3-expanded-scope-register.md (produced by scripts/generate-story-174-3-scope-register.mjs from the origin/main comparison plus current story files, regenerated before freeze) is the current file-level coordination authority for the 174.3 remediation, superseding the historical three-file bootstrap; it enumerates 424 files in coordination classes led by route-owner-remediation (335 files) and story-evidence (46 files).

The 174.3 execution-manifest indexer (indexStory1743ExecutionManifest in e2e/fixtures/story-174-3/execution-manifest.ts) keys results by (source, scenarioId) and fails closed on missing entries, stale source SHA-256 hashes, runner mismatches, non-passed results or non-zero exit codes, and incomplete runner metadata; with requireExactSet it also rejects every surplus entry, enforcing exact key-set equality with the canonical execution union for merge readiness.

The shared manifest reader scripts/lib/story-174-3-manifest.mjs permits an empty manifest only for a true ENOENT and otherwise rejects malformed JSON, unsupported schema, missing runtime metadata, duplicate entries, and malformed fields — requiring a 64-hex sourceSha256, supported vitest/playwright runner, supported passed/failed/skipped result, integer exitCode, valid ISO timestamps, and non-negative durationMs per entry.

scripts/lib/story-174-3-execution-requirements.mjs derives the exact required-execution set by parsing the owner declaration fixtures with the TypeScript compiler, accepting only literal source/scenarioId/runner arguments in bind/binding/scenario helper calls, rejecting conflicting runners, and pinning each entry to a SHA-256 of its current source file so the committed manifest cannot go stale silently.

Contract tests under src/test/story-174-3-*.test.ts enforce the manifest-reader, state, surface, and manual-evidence contracts of the 174.3 pipeline: state-contract tests validate route/state dispositions, owner reconciliation, and merge-ready execution indexing; surface-contract tests validate 76 route surface contracts (overlays 83 executed/15 N/A, tables 42/21, charts 13/4, table/chart features 292 executed/331 N/A) with fail-closed conditional branches.

The 174.3 route/state evidence matrix materializes all 76 × 12 = 912 rows as 444 exact executed rows, 468 explicit route-specific not-applicable rows, and 0 blocked rows, plus 76 canonical Story-runner defaults, 318 owner-unit and 50 owner-browser executable rows; the former title-token fallback was deleted so absence of a substring can never become N/A and every declared executable scenario must resolve exactly once.

Story 174.3 evidence honesty rules: authenticated screenshots, videos, traces, ARIA snapshots, and raw attachments are prohibited (privacy-safe DOM/accessibility/geometry/computed-style data only, with auth/report/playwright-cli artifacts deleted after validation); true 200% zoom runs through real browser-UI shortcuts proving doubled DPR across all 76 routes × both themes; and unavailable real assistive-technology environments (VoiceOver/NVDA/JAWS/TalkBack) are recorded as explicit gaps, never relabeled as passes.

The final 174.3 exact-worktree validation ledger recorded the committed execution manifest at 770 passed entries (627 Vitest / 143 Playwright) with 0 failed, full Vitest 19,355/19,355 across 1,270 files, the canonical Story runner at 82 passed / 1 optional Manager skip, owner-browser regeneration 368 passed / 22 accepted skips, real 200% zoom for all 76 routes in both themes, and a 70/70-page production build — while the immutable pre-merge three-APPROVE gate remained pending.

Per-story migration status lives in _bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/sprint-status.yaml (live history) and the consolidated snapshot _bmad-output/planning-artifacts/shadcn-migration-status-and-debt-registry.md; on drift, the repository is truth, corrected through a reviewable documentation lane.

The 174.3 matrix discovered and remediated RED→GREEN product defects as coordinated owner repairs, including replacing invalid tr role=button semantics with named native buttons owning keyboard activation (pricing, elasticity, monitoring, supplies, top-products, top-brands), contrast fixes on the sidebar destructive badge and dashboard status strip, exact accessible table/chart names with screen-reader data alternatives, and rendering stable localized recovery copy instead of raw API-derived error text on finance-history failures.

The migration program is complete: 94/94 stories done across Epics 166-174 (all CLOSED), timeline 2026-08-11 to 2026-09-02, final main base 0d6225acb9abfafa872d2d2ee45f215594edc4e6, and all 76 route-ledger rows flipped planned to verified only by Story 174.5 after a per-row evidence audit (54 rows with complete per-story chains, 22 early-wave rows whose cleanup link is satisfied by a collective live-absence audit after an independent verifier refuted 4 builder-map rows).

After program completion, check-shadcn-migration-parity.mjs is a terminal-state regression guard pinned to EXPECTED_BASE_SHA 0d6225ac (the Story 174.5 base) with the ledger expectation moved to verified: it reports base-sha-mismatch BY DESIGN when run on post-merge main, and must be re-run in a worktree based on the pinned SHA or re-pinned to a new base; corpus-only mode is STORY_174_1_SKIP_SELF_TESTS=1.

Post-migration debt is owner-scoped aftermath, none blocking, and its P0 items are resolved: PB-1 (silent cabinet-create on nonce-less sessions) via D-1 (session-2, PR #390, ensureSessionNonce initiation-mint + indeterminate recovery alert + finishRecoveryOperation release), PB-3 (no reactive 401-refresh) via D-2 (2026-09-03, single-flight store-token interceptor, live-verified against a locally rebuilt BE), plus PB-2, PB-4, the /15- and /10-family contrast fixes, C13/C15, FE-D9 logApiError redaction, and SEC-DOC-1 credential redaction + owner rotation; the final handoff Debt escalation register (updated in place by the sessions) holds statuses, fix-canons, and evidence.

Story 174.4 fixed ~53 baseline-failing spec tests plus two real product WCAG/layout defects, resolved the 13 bisect-proven pre-existing liquidity/monitor e2e failures, ratcheted the ui-boundary baseline 523 down to 459, and regenerated Story 174.3's SHA-pinned owner-browser execution manifest (367 passed / 0 failed / 23 skipped) via scripts/run-story-174-3-state-evidence.mjs --owner-browsers — the only permitted regeneration path, since any edit to a pinned e2e spec breaks module-load of the whole e2e suite.
